definitions.explanation: A highly formal and humble first-person plural pronoun used in business and service contexts.

examples.japanese: {私|わたくし}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{任|まか}せ→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{私|わたくし}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{選|えら}び→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for choosing our products.

examples.japanese: {私|わたくし}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{要望|ようぼう}→要望：14111_youbou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{応|こた}え→応える：09893_kotaeru⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧まいります。
examples.english: We will do our utmost to meet our customers' needs.

notes:
A very formal humble pronoun formed from ⟦{私|わたくし}→私：02987_watakushi⟧ (I, formal) + ど⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (humble plural suffix). Used primarily in business, hospitality, and customer service to represent one's organization or group in a humble manner. The ど⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ suffix is inherently humble, lowering the speaker's group relative to the listener.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私|わたくし}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: our company (humble)
- {私|わたくし}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: our shop (humble)
- {私|わたくし}ども⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いたしまし→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ては: as far as we are concerned (very formal)

USAGE:
Primarily used in business correspondence, formal speeches, and customer-facing situations. Hotel staff, airline attendants, and salespeople frequently use this pronoun. It would sound overly stiff in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧: we — standard and gender-neutral; appropriate for most situations
- ⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧: we — formal but not humble; used in speeches and announcements
- ⟦{僕|ぼく}ら→僕ら：22784_bokura⟧: we — informal and masculine
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: our company (humble) — specifically refers to one's company rather than a group of people
